note: v57.19 — SEC page projection back under its 1 MiB bound (P1470).

p.title: SEC page projection back under its 1 MiB bound
p.symptom: Every screener refresh after v57.18 failed: 'runtime projection exceeds 1 MiB: 1089778' (630 records with the P1446 cash-flow fields). The interrupted session's compact-serialization fix referenced mkdir/dirname without importing them (ReferenceError) and was never run.
p.root_cause: The projection was pretty-printed and carried per-record source/model strings identical to its header.
p.fix: The data block serializes compactly behind a pretty header; per-record source/model (uniform, restated by the header; consumers fall back to the same value) and the redundant StockholdersEquity concept are trimmed, keeping conflict evidence. The stray mkdir call is removed. 977 KB → 702 KB for 608 records.
p.violated_rule: Takeover review of v57.18 (2026-10-04): a number must state what it was computed on, a validation claim must be about the model actually on screen, and a gate is fixed by making the producer state its evidence — never by skipping the records it rejects.
p.prevention: ci-sec-runtime-projection-check (bound, parent-equity identity with the trimmed concept).
p.verification: node scripts/build-sec-runtime-projection.mjs then ci-sec-runtime-projection-check: OK, 701,596 bytes.

changelog: **SEC 요약 크기 한도 복구 (P1470):** 1MiB를 넘어 매 스크리너 갱신을 실패시키던 SEC 요약을 702KB로 줄였습니다.
